summary: Require bilingual interpretation and sourced locally adjustable index classes
details: User requests documentation of each index output meaning/range, whether classification is internationally standardized, class descriptions and local threshold adjustment with scientifically accurate labels. Audit: generated catalogs have formulas/band roles/citations but not complete interpretation tables; scientific-methods guide points to tables that are absent. Add PLAN-0015 r5 requirements and acceptance; do not claim universal NDVI thresholds or implemented classification controls.
